title: Object Cleanup Findings
description: Per-object cleanup-candidate findings produced by AccessHarvester identify-cleanup. See docs/planning/object-cleanup-strategy.md for the design specification.

database.description: Name of the harvested Access database (without path or extension).

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the file was generated.

harvestDate.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) anchoring the date-signal threshold. Date-only because the threshold is day-based. Defaults to the process's local date when --harvest-date is omitted.

dateSignalSource.description: Path used overall for §3.2 date sampling. 'com' = primary COM-based DateMaximaSampler succeeded for at least one table; 'dao-metadata' = COM was skipped/unavailable and IR LastUpdated was used; 'unavailable' = neither path produced data.

thresholdDays.description: Date-signal threshold in days. A table's max DateTime value more than this many days before harvestDate fires the DateSignal. Default 90; --threshold-days overrides.

degradationNotes.description: Zero-or-more human-readable strings, one per signal path that ran in a degraded mode (e.g., query SQL absent so QueryTableReference detection coverage was reduced; COM declined and no LastUpdated values present so DateSignal path produced no findings). Empty array when all signal paths ran at full fidelity. See strategy doc §5 for example messages.

findings.description: One entry per object with at least one fired signal. Sorted by (confidenceTier desc, objectType asc, objectName asc). Objects with zero fired signals are not present.

objectName.description: The Access object name exactly as it appears in the database.

confidenceTier.description: Categorical confidence. Current analyzer output is High = NamePattern AND DateSignal both fired, Medium = exactly one of NamePattern or DateSignal fired. Low is retained for backward compatibility with historical outputs and is not emitted by the current analyzer.

explanation.description: One-sentence human-readable why-flagged summary, suitable for display as ItemLabel in the uat-checklist-editor checklist. See strategy doc §5 for templates.

firedSignals.description: Every signal that fired for this object. At least one entry; non-fired signals are not recorded.

summary.description: Human-readable description of which pattern matched.

matchedSubstring.description: The exact substring of the object name that triggered the match (e.g., '_OLD', '2023', 'Jan2024').

category.description: Which name-pattern category fired. See strategy doc §3.1.

summary.description: Human-readable description of the date observation.

source.description: Source of the maxValue for this specific signal. 'com' = sampled via DateMaximaSampler; 'dao-metadata' = read from IR LastUpdated. The top-level dateSignalSource summarises the overall run.

maxValue.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time of the latest data observed for the table. Must include a UTC offset (`Z` or `+/-HH:MM`); naive timestamps without timezone are not valid. When the source is DAO `LastUpdated` (no timezone info), emit `Z` to assert UTC.

daysSinceMax.description: Whole days between maxValue and harvestDate.

thresholdDays.description: The effective threshold used for this finding. The DateSignal fires only when daysSinceMax > thresholdDays.

signalType.description: Discriminator for tagged-union Signal. Retained for backward compatibility with historical outputs; the current cleanup analyzer does not emit this signal.

summary.description: Human-readable summary listing the reference types that were checked and came up empty.

checkedReferenceTypes.description: Reference types the detector applied for this object type, all of which produced no evidence. See strategy doc §3.3 for the per-object-type matrix.
